name: Object Storage
description: Object storage — also called a bucket, blob storage, S3, GCS, Azure Blob, or unstructured store — a key-addressed store for files, blobs, backups, and media. Accessed over HTTP APIs and a common home for large unstructured data. The place to look for object storage, an S3/GCS/Azure bucket, blob store, or where backups, media, and unstructured files are kept.
